text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- The presidents and prime ministers of NATO and NATO partner countries have opened a summit in Madrid.
-- Moscow said the admission of the Czech Republic, Poland and Hungary into the NATO will have unpredictable consequences.
-- The average wage increase in 1998 will be maximum 16 percent.
-- The police have found almost all the banknote paper missing.
-- The highest grade of flood alert has been introduced in the Szigetkoz region, along the upper stretch of the Danube in Hungary.
